name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Mirror Acrylic Art Pieces
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality natural wood and mirror acrylic, offering a stylish, elegant, and eye-catching display finish.
    - Features a 2-layer construction that creates a dimensional effect and enhances the overall decorative appearance.
    - Layer 1 is made of wood with 3mm thickness, providing a sturdy base and a warm handcrafted feel.
    - Layer 2 is made of mirror acrylic and wood with 3mm thickness, adding a reflective and premium visual accent.
    - Available in 2 mirror acrylic options: Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic.
    - Comes with a wooden stand included for stable and convenient tabletop display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing & Engraving Technology:
    - Combines engraving on mirror acrylic with printing UV on wood for a layered and eye-catching effect.
    - Layer 1: 2-sided printing
    - Layer 2: Engraving on mirror acrylic, 1-sided printing on wood.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized decorative art piece and a meaningful keepsake display.
    - Designed for tabletop display on desks, shelves, countertops, mantels, or memory corners.
    - The included wooden stand allows easy setup and stable presentation.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, classroom décor, and personalized gift displays.
    - Perfect for showcasing names, heartfelt messages, appreciation themes, and memorable moments in a stylish way.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for teachers, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation, birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for thank-you gifts, memorial keepsakes, and personalized decorative displays.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving meaningful names, messages, and memories in an elegant format.
    - Great for desk décor, shelf décor, and commemorative display collections.
    - Adds a warm, refined, and memorable touch to any space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And Mirror Acrylic Art Pieces

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
